title: My Brilliant Friend
description:
S01 E01 — Le Bambole (The Dolls)
The disappearance of her old friend, Lila Cerrullo, causes 60-year-old author Elena Greco to reflect on the early days of their friendship in the 1950s Naples, when Elena and Lila are two very different girls at the top of their class.

title: My Brilliant Friend
description:
S01 E02 — I Soldi (The Money)
As fourth grade draws to an end, Elena and Lila fight with their families for the chance to continue their education; a trip out of town becomes a day Elena will never forget; a death changes things in the neighborhood forever.

title: My Brilliant Friend
description:
S01 E03 — Le Metamorfosi (The Metamorphoses)
Elena grapples with the onset of puberty, her studies and her friendship with Lila, who now works in her family's shoe-repair store; as the girls' encounters with the opposite sex become more frequent, Lila takes a stand against the Solara brothers.

title: My Brilliant Friend
description:
S01 E04 — Le Smarginatura (Dissolving Margins)
Entering high school, Elena vows to stay ahead of Lila, academically and romantically; promising a better future for the neighborhood, Stefano Carracci invites Elena, Lila and their families over for New Year's Eve.

title: My Brilliant Friend
description:
S01 E05 — Le Scarpe (The Shoes)
Elena grows tired of Gino, while Lila rejects two potential suitors at a cost; a rare outing into the city turns violent; Elena worries about not being there for Lila after accepting an invitation to spend the summer away from the neighborhood.

title: My Brilliant Friend
description:
S01 E06 — L'isola (The Island)
On the island of Ischia, Elena runs into the Sarratore family, reigniting her childhood crush on Nino; Lila's resistance to Marcello's pressing courtship reaches a breaking point; an unexpected encounter leaves Elena shaken on her 15th birthday.

title: My Brilliant Friend
description:
S01 E07 — I Fidanzati (The Fiancés)
Elena returns to Naples to find Lila has made a romantic connection with Stefano, despite the looming presence of Marcello.

title: My Brilliant Friend
description:
S01 E08 — La Promessa (The Promise)
With sales of Cerullo shoes lagging, Stefano cuts a business deal with the Solaras; after Elena gets kicked out of a class for voicing her opinion, Nino encourages her to write an article about her experience for his magazine.

title: My Brilliant Friend: The Story of a New Name
description:
S02 E01 — The New Name
Newly-married Lila grows profoundly resentful of her husband and finds new ways to carry on seeing Elena.

title: My Brilliant Friend: The Story of a New Name
description:
S02 E02 — The Body
A photograph of Lila on her wedding day is exhibited at a shop in the center of town, triggering admiration and gossip throughout the neighborhood.

title: My Brilliant Friend: The Story of a New Name
description:
S02 E03 — Erasure
Lila continues to hold a grudge against Stefano as the shoe shop opens and she goes to work at his new grocery store; Elena brings Lila to a party at her teacher's home.

title: My Brilliant Friend: The Story of a New Name
description:
S02 E04 — The Kiss
Elena agrees to a holiday in Ischia with Lila, knowing that Nino Sarratore will also be on the island.

title: My Brilliant Friend: The Story of a New Name
description:
S02 E05 — The Betrayal
On Ischia, an agonizing rift begins to form between Elena and Lila, as they adapt to their new roles in a new city.

title: My Brilliant Friend: The Story of a New Name
description:
S02 E06 — Rage
Elena plunges headfirst into her academic future, while Lila tackles problems of an entirely different nature.

title: My Brilliant Friend: The Story of a New Name
description:
S02 E07 — Ghosts
In reading Lila's private diaries, Elena, now an accomplished college student, realizes how much her friend's new role has changed her.

title: My Brilliant Friend: The Story of a New Name
description:
S02 E08 — The Blue Fairy
Elena is struck with inspiration and begins to write her first novel; she gives the manuscript to Pietro Airota before returning to Naples.

title: My Brilliant Friend
description:
S03 E01 — Indecencies
At the Milanese presentation of her book, Elena unexpectedly meets Nino, who defends her from a particularly aggressive journalist; Elena's future mother-in-law, Adele, is very impressed by Nino and invites him to have dinner with them.

title: My Brilliant Friend
description:
S03 E02 — The Fever
Pietro is in Naples to meet his future in-laws; Elena is very nervous, but her betrothed and the Greco family get along well; mother complains and tries to get Elena to change her mind about the civil ceremony; Lila sends for Elena.

title: My Brilliant Friend
description:
S03 E03 — The Treatment
Elena writes an article exposing the conditions at the Soccavo plant; Lila is determined to move back to the neighborhood.

title: My Brilliant Friend
description:
S03 E04 — Cold War
On their wedding day, Adele surprises Elena and Pietro; Elena struggles to write after the birth of her daughter.

title: My Brilliant Friend
description:
S03 E05 — Terror
Elena embraces the feminist struggle and argues with Pietro about it; Pasquale and Nadia show up at Elena's house; their chaotic behavior upsets Pietro.

title: My Brilliant Friend
description:
S03 E06 — Becoming
After receiving shocking news from Lila about Elisa, Elena cuts the family holiday short to return to Naples.

title: My Brilliant Friend
description:
S03 E07 — Try Again
With her marriage on the edge, Elena is further destabilized when Pietro brings Nino home for an unexpected visit.

title: My Brilliant Friend
description:
S03 E08 — Those who leave, those who stay
Elena meets Nino's family; he shows great interest in her new book, while Pietro seems increasingly distant.

title: My Brilliant Friend
description:
S04 E01 — The Separation
Elena considers moving back to Naples after being chastised by both Immacolata and Adele; Lila shares shocking news about Nino.

title: My Brilliant Friend
description:
S04 E02 — The Dispersion
Unable to forgive Nino's betrayal, Elena decides to bring Dede and Elsa to stay at Mariarosa and Franco's home in Milan.

title: My Brilliant Friend
description:
S04 E03 — Compromises
On a visit to the neighborhood for the first time in years, Elena attempts to make peace with Immacolata and learns that her mother has been unwell; when Elena and Nino return from a trip to New York, she and Lila grow closer.

title: My Brilliant Friend
description:
S04 E04 — The Earthquake
After spending a day together, a sudden earthquake sends terror through Naples as Lila and Elena try to reunite with their families.

title: My Brilliant Friend
description:
S04 E05 — The Fracture
After Elena's daughter Imma's birth, Lila brings Elena's mother to see the baby, but the visit is unexpectedly cut short when Immacolata collapses; when Nino and Lila take Immacolata to the hospital, Elena finds herself plagued with jealousy.

title: My Brilliant Friend
description:
S04 E06 — The Cheat
After a tragic loss and stunned by Nino's actions yet again, Elena takes refuge at Lila's and finally learns the truth about him.

title: My Brilliant Friend
description:
S04 E07 — The Return
Still reeling from her breakup, Elena reconnects with Antonio, who shares the full extent of Nino's betrayals; Elena discovers that her new book is a success; tensions run high at Elisa and Marcello's wedding.

title: My Brilliant Friend
description:
S04 E08 — The Investigation
After Elena discovers that Carmen has been pressured into suing her for slander, she and Lila decide to work together on a report of the Solaras' affairs; Elena learns that their article may not be enough to put the brothers behind bars.

title: My Brilliant Friend
description:
S04 E09 — The Disappearance
During Nino's long overdue visit to see Imma, a sudden and mysterious disappearance rocks the neighborhood; the Solaras help organize a search, Enzo remains suspicious of their involvement; Lila becomes consumed by her own conspiracies.

title: My Brilliant Friend
description:
S04 E10 — The Restitution
Elena tries to manage a crisis when Elsa runs away from home; many years later, Lila manages to surprise her friend yet again.

S01 E01 — The Hidden Hand
On Wallach IX, young Valya Harkonnen promises Mother Superior Raquella that she'll protect the Sisterhood by putting one of their own on the Imperial Throne; thirty years later, Valya faces a threat to her long-awaited plan.

title: Dune: Prophecy

S01 E02 — Two Wolves
Two Harkonnen sisters combat forces that threaten the future of humankind and establish the fabled sect that will be known as the Bene Gesserit.

title: Dune: Prophecy
description:
S01 E03 — Sisterhood Above All
Following a tragedy, young Tula worries about being accepted despite her family name; a skeptical Valya struggles with the decision to take the Sisterhood vow; years later, Valya receives a message that confirms her suspicions.

title: Dune: Prophecy
description:
S01 E04 — Twice Born
Tula tries to understand the origins of the nightmare that affects all acolytes of the sisterhood; as Tula attempts to understand the acolytes' shared dream, Valya sets her plan in motion to redeem House Harkonnen ahead of the Landsraad.

title: Dune: Prophecy
description:
S01 E05 — In Blood, Truth
As Corrino names a new Bashar, a Sister with deep connections to the Emperor arrives on Salusa Secundus; after receiving a tip, Desmond goes on a warpath to root out the insurgents; Tula tries to keep her secret project from being discovered.

title: Dune: Prophecy
description:
S01 E06 — The High-Handed Enemy
As Tula contends with the reveal of Desmond's true identity, the acolytes uncover a devastating long-held secret about the Sisterhood.
